records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net revenue decreased by $16.6 million, or 5.1%, during the three months ended October 1, 2022 compared to the same period a year ago.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Additionally, we have seen demand for our NE and SE products affected by macroeconomic uncertainty.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Product revenues decreased by $21.4 million, or 7.4%, during the three months ended October 1, 2022 compared to the same period a year ago, driven by revenue decreases in all segments.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Through continued economic challenges, there continue to be periodic shipping and logistics challenges and continued supply chain constraints, shortages and delays, along with inflationary pricing pressures.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the three months ended October 1, 2022, Cash provided by operating activities was $26.6 million, consisting of net income of $32.6 million adjusted for non-cash charges (e.g. depreciation, amortization, stock-based compensation and other non-cash items) which totaled $27.6 million, including changes in deferred tax balances, and changes in operating assets and liabilities that used $33.6 million.
